description: MEDBFS supplies more than 7,000 optical satellite images of buildings before and after five earthquakes. The Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences describes three damage classes and 16 feature-image classes derived from spectral, texture, edge, building-index and temporal information. Its ScienceDB page confirms the named collection, with free access under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The images cover selected disasters at several spatial resolutions; a uniform acquisition period and file format are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource can help validate remote damage classification used in building exposure and emergency-response simulations. Satellite appearance and expert labels do not directly specify structural fragility curves. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
